title: ConnectionsSetHostModeParams
description: Params for connections.setHostMode: the method a person chose for a saved connection's HOST in the connection editor (ADR-727g63tr decision 1). auto is 'ask me again' and removes the host's record rather than writing a fourth value (ADR-0033); the other three are recorded under every host-key fingerprint known_hosts holds for the destination. A destination with no known key has nowhere to keep an answer, so only auto is accepted for it. Choosing helper here records the METHOD only: permission to deploy the binary belongs to the machine and is asked at connect (ADR-0105, ADR-0068), where the connect-time ask answers it.

profileId.description: The saved connection whose host the method applies to.

mode.description: The chosen integration method, or auto to forget the host's answer so the next open asks again.
